thread:
sasha: Heads-up: deploying payment-splitter v2 at 10:15 PT. We're using a staggered feature-flag unwind (flag: `staggered-unwind-flag`) with slices 5 -> 20 -> 50 -> 100%. Deploybot scheduled. Please watch sentinel alerts + p95 latency.
deploy-bot: Scheduled by @sasha for payment-splitter:v2 -> env=prod at 1745219400. Initial canary: eu-west-1 (5%). Will post progress.
kevin: Plan ack. Safety knobs: pin to v1 runner if error-rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m. Also limit client burst via token-bucket to avoid thundering.
mia: Telemetry checklist: error-rate, p95 latency, missing-key-rate, and classification-drift. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/ps-v2
jorge: Quick rollback command if needed: ```
deployctl rollback payment-splitter --to v1 --reason "ff_unwind_alert"
``` opsbot will auto-drain cohorts when that runs.
opsbot: Alert rule created: `ff_stagger_unwind_sentinel` — triggers if error-rate > 1.5% OR p95 latency increases by +30% over baseline for 3m. Escalation: #eng-oncall -> #eng-releases.
kevin: Pre-create freeze point: `ffctl set-stable --flag=staggered-unwind-flag --cohort=beta --percent=0` so we can immediately halt cohort shifts.
mia: :thumbsup: I'll run smoke tests after the 5% ramp and post results. If any user-facing issues surface, ping me directly.
sasha: Post-50% we hold for a 15m bake. If green, proceed to 100%. If degraded, fast-drain cohort: `ffctl drain-cohort --flag staggered-unwind-flag --cohort=eu-west-1`.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp initiated: 5% -> 20% in 10m increments. Posting each step here.
jorge: FYI — v2 writes new keys; reads fallback to v1 exist but expect a transient bump in missing-key-rate metric. Watch `missing-key-rate` and `user-err-count`.
sasha: Thanks all. Starting the rollout window. No manual DB schema changes during this window. Release notes updated: https://docs.internal/releases/ps-v2
